scope.selection_note: User narrowed the corpus to the currently relevant Ali Abdaal and Jeff Su folders before this taxonomy pass.

production_status_legend.renderable_v1: Good enough to drive deterministic v1 composition with current host cutouts, blurred A-roll backgrounds, text, cards, icons, arrows, and simple UI panels.
production_status_legend.reference_only: Useful as visual inspiration, but should not be selected for automated v1 rendering until the renderer or asset library is extended.
production_status_legend.archive: Keep the assignment for coverage, but do not use as a production template.

families.label: simple metaphor control + host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/5 Easy Ways to Become More Self-Disciplined.jpg
best_for: one abstract concept that can become a UI metaphor

host.gaze_policy: Host may look at the metaphor component or camera; face must stay secondary to the simple switch.

typography.headline_policy: Usually no separate headline; the component text is the headline.

background.policy: soft blurred room or simple gradient; low detail behind the metaphor.

template_breakers: component no longer reads as a simple metaphor
shot_needs: hands holding or touching one object

families.label: host with icon/object cluster
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/5 High Income Skills for Students to Learn in 2026.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/8 Simple Habits That Save Me 20+ Hours a Week.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/I Tried 137 Productivity Tools. These Are The Best..jpg

host.gaze_policy: Camera-facing host can anchor a loose cluster; side gaze should point toward the densest cluster.

typography.headline_policy: Optional; if present, use one short count or phrase, not a bottom Shosho headline.

background.policy: blurred A-roll or clean studio; icon contrast must beat background detail.

template_breakers: all icons have equal weight with no focal path

families.label: large year/number hero + host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/6 Habits to Make 2026 Your Best Year Yet.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/How to Make Next Year The Best Year of Your Life.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host can face camera; the giant year/number owns the first glance.

typography.headline_policy: One huge number/year plus one tiny modifier at most.

background.policy: clean bright background with low detail.

families.label: income/platform cards around host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/6 Side Hustles Students Can Start in 2026.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/How to Make $10,000Month Writing Online.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/If I Wanted to Make $10,000 as a Student, I'd Do This.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Camera-facing or pointing host anchors several cards; do not select a side-gaze pose unless cards are in that direction.

typography.headline_policy: Use money metric as the text anchor; avoid full subtitle paragraphs.

background.policy: warm clean room or neutral gradient; cards must be brighter than background.

template_breakers: host gaze points away from cards

families.label: large blunt phrase + host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/9 Things I Wish I Knew When I Started YouTube.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/How To Get Rich.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/Why Everyone Should Start a YouTube Channel.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host should either face camera or point at the phrase; side gaze must not point off-canvas.

typography.headline_policy: The big phrase is the design. 2-5 words, high contrast, no second headline.

background.policy: plain or blurred background; text contrast is the main constraint.

families.label: diagram/whiteboard as main payload
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/How to Control Dopamine (You're Destroying Your Mind).jpg
avoid: fast production v1 unless a clean diagram renderer exists

host.gaze_policy: Host is optional; diagram clarity is primary.

typography.headline_policy: Diagram labels are allowed; avoid bottom headline overlays.

background.policy: light board or paper, minimal texture.

template_breakers: random decorative icons replace causal structure
shot_needs: optional pointing-to-board pose if this becomes production

families.label: large UI/productivity panel opposite host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/How to Find Time for Everything with a Full Time Job.jpg
avoid: abstract advice with no screen metaphor
dense tool tutorial better suited to Jeff style

host.gaze_policy: Host gaze or gesture must point toward the panel; do not put a right-looking host on the left if the panel is also right.

typography.headline_policy: Panel title may exist; no large bottom headline unless the reference variant has one.

background.policy: blurred work room, panel contrast high.

template_breakers: panel and gaze are on same side
panel is too small to explain the promise

families.label: before/after transformation split
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/How to Reset Your Dopamine (And Change Your Life).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/How to Stop Wasting Your Life (Avoid These 5 Things).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/Why You’re Always Distracted - 5 Mistakes Ruining Your Focus.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Before/after sides must align with host expression or gesture; confused pose on before side, confident pose on after side.

typography.headline_policy: Use two contrast labels or one short warning phrase; no paragraph.

background.policy: split warm/cool or before/after color contrast.

template_breakers: before and after do not read as opposites
host expression does not match the side

families.label: evidence stack or objects as proof
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/I Read 107 Productivity Books. Here's What Actually Works..jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host can be smaller if object/evidence stack is the main proof.

typography.headline_policy: One count badge or short conclusion phrase.

background.policy: warm study/library, object stack sharply separated.

template_breakers: object stack looks like random decoration

families.label: metric contrast + arrow
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/If I Wanted to Be a Millionaire Before 30, I'd Do This.jpg
avoid: benefits with no two clear metrics

host.gaze_policy: Camera-facing or two-hand comparison pose; metrics must flank the host symmetrically.

typography.headline_policy: The two metric badges are the text. No separate headline.

background.policy: simple room background; keep metric contrast dominant.

template_breakers: host not centered enough to bridge metrics
shot_needs: center metric pose with two hands outward

families.label: social/quote card + approachable host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/My honest advice to someone who feels behind in life.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Ali Abdaal/My honest advice to someone who wants financial freedom.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host should feel present and approachable; card is usually opposite host.

typography.headline_policy: Card carries 3-7 words; no extra headline.

background.policy: soft blurred room, low detail, human warmth.

families.label: tool label + UI panel + host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Google Keep Top 11 Tips for Insane Digital Organization!.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Learn 80% of Perplexity in under 10 minutes!.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Learn 80% of NotebookLM in Under 13 Minutes!.jpg

E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/給入門者的Google AI課程 (只要10分鐘)!.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host must either face camera or look/point at the UI panel. If the reference host is centered, choose a camera-facing cutout, not a side-gaze cutout.

typography.headline_policy: Use a product label and one concise UI label. Do not add large handwritten bottom text.

background.policy: cool/neutral blurred A-roll background with vertical office texture; very low detail.

template_breakers: UI panel becomes a blank rectangle
host gaze points away from the payload

families.label: dark command/correction panel + host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/95% of People STILL Prompt ChatGPT-5 Wrong.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/How to Create Cinematic AI Videos (No-BS Guide).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/The CORRECT way to use ChatGPT (in 2026).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Why 90% of AI Presentations Fail (do this instead).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/寫出完美的ChatGPT指令 8分鐘搞定！.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host should point toward the correction panel or face camera while the panel owns the opposite side.

typography.headline_policy: One strong correction phrase, usually inside the panel or attached label.

background.policy: dark UI or blurred office; panel edges and text must be crisp.

families.label: dark background + app/logo cluster + host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/99% of Beginners Don't Know the Basics of AI.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/A GENIUS Way to use ChatGPT for Presentations!.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/AI Agents, Clearly Explained.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/I Switched 50% of My AI Work to Claude, Here's Why.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/The Only AI Tools You Need (12-Minute Guide).jpg
best_for: many logos but one clear thesis

host.gaze_policy: Camera-facing smile can hold a logo cluster; if gaze is sideward, cluster must sit in gaze direction.

typography.headline_policy: Optional short concept label; logos should carry most of the meaning.

background.policy: dark cool gradient or blurred office; logos need bright high-contrast cards.

template_breakers: logos are not semantically tied to title

families.label: two tool cards compared around host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/How to Create Cinematic AI Videos (No-BS Guide).jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host sits between the two cards, camera-facing or looking at the stronger card.

typography.headline_policy: Each card gets one product label. No extra bottom headline.

background.policy: cool blurred A-roll, symmetrical spacing.

families.label: one large UI/document panel opposite host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/10 INCREDIBLE things Google Sheets can do Right Now!.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Beginner to Pro with ChatGPT in One Video!.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Master Data Analysis with ChatGPT (in just 12 minutes).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/My Simple Claude Cowork System (for normal people).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Notion was HARD until I Learned These 8 Tips!.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Panel must be opposite host or slightly behind host hand. If reference is panel-left host-right, match that relationship.

typography.headline_policy: Panel may include short UI labels; avoid giant standalone text.

background.policy: blurred office, panel has strong foreground separation.

template_breakers: panel is on same side as gaze
host face smaller than UI label

families.label: numbered/time-saving metric + app cue
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/8個增加工作生產力的ChatGPT使用祕訣！.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host should face or point toward the metric/app cue.

typography.headline_policy: One giant number or time metric plus a tiny label.

background.policy: dark/neutral background with high-contrast metric.

template_breakers: metric is not the biggest text

families.label: large text panel/slogan with host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/How I Manage My Time - 8 Tips that Changed My Life.jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Master Gemini 3.1 for Work in 12 Minutes (2026).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/NotebookLM Changed Completely Here's What Matters (in 2026).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Why Your Cover Letter Gets Rejected (5 MISTAKES TO AVOID).jpg
avoid: when a concrete UI card would explain better

host.gaze_policy: Host expression reinforces the text; panel should not cover face.

typography.headline_policy: This template is typography-first. 2-6 words in bold sans, not handwritten glow.

background.policy: clean blurred office or dark panel; keep text area quiet.

template_breakers: text wraps into too many lines
font style drifts into Shosho handwritten thumbnail

families.label: roadmap/diagram board with host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/The AI Agent Tutorial That Should've Been Your First (no code).jpg
E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/You're Not Behind Become AI-Native (without the overwhelm).jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host points to or frames the board; board must stay readable.

typography.headline_policy: Few big board labels; no dense roadmap details.

background.policy: dark or neutral background; board is foreground.

template_breakers: host does not interact with board

families.label: two-step/checklist cards + host
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/The Productivity System I Taught to 6,642 Googlers.jpg

host.gaze_policy: Host can sit beside stacked cards; cards should be opposite host.

typography.headline_policy: Each card gets one short verb phrase.

background.policy: clean blurred office or neutral background.

template_breakers: cards become equal to full paragraphs

families.label: editorial trend collage
example_paths: E:/thumbnail-example/Jeff Su/Top 6 AI Trends That Will Define 2026 (backed by data).jpg
best_for: trend report with many external references
avoid: any thumbnail needing fast reliable quality

host.gaze_policy: No stable v1 host rule.

typography.headline_policy: Editorial collage text; too variable for v1.

background.policy: custom editorial collage.

template_breakers: v1 renderer cannot produce editorial collage quality
